items.headline: Open-weight model announced with a day-one NVIDIA container
items.source_excerpt: In a statement, Mistral said the new model will be open-weight under an Apache 2.0 licence. NVIDIA said it will ship as an optimised container in NIM on launch day. Neither company gave a price for hosted access.

items.headline: ETH Zurich releases SafeRoute
items.source_excerpt: Researchers at ETH Zurich released SafeRoute, a dataset of 40,000 tool-call traces labelled for unsafe actions. The dataset is released under CC-BY-4.0, and the annotation work took eleven weeks.
